appearance_facts.fact: Title 'District Heating Demand Index' appears in large bold black text.
Vertical axis labeled 'Demand index' with tick marks at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20.
Horizontal axis labeled 'Year' with tick marks for 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015.
A single blue line connects black circular data points, showing a consistent downward trend from left to right.
Each data point has a text annotation above it indicating a temperature value in °C.
The line begins at the highest vertical position on the left, corresponding to the year 2005.
The line ends at the lowest vertical position on the right, corresponding to the year 2015.
